arStrings.szText: The brambles are gone, but the damage they did is irreversible. Countless innocents consumed by the forest itself. Twisted into horrific creatures. At the heart of it all is Mephisto and his Hands of Akarat. Did they perform the dark ritual here just to stop us from pursuing Lilith's blade? I must continue the search, no matter the cost.

Tharra is still suspicious of us, but she has given us a lead. The local Archivists might be able to help find any artifacts kept in the Temple. During the attack, these keepers of knowledge barricaded themselves inside a chamber nearby. I must find them.

A Firstborn archive sits beneath the Temple, and it might hold clues about Lilith's blade. Yet we are not the first to come looking for this place. The Hands of Akarat ventured into it already. I must find the archive before Mephisto's servants befoul it.
